steps.description: In the "Input volume" section, select the CT volume for processing.

operations.description: Select the CT volume to process.

steps.description: If ROI crop of the volume is required, check the "Crop the input volume to an ROI" box. If not, jump to step 7.

operations.description: Optionally crop the volume to an ROI; if not required, skip the ROI crop steps to step 7.

steps.description: In the "Markups" module, click "ROI" to create an empty MarkupsROI node named "Longbone_Region".

operations.description: Create an empty MarkupsROI node named Longbone_Region in the Markups module.

steps.description: Manually click and adjust on the Slice views to create the ROI for the "Longbone_Region".

operations.description: Place the ROI by clicking and adjusting it in the Slice views.

interaction.placement_instructions: Click and adjust in the Slice views to draw the ROI bounding box around the long bone region.

steps.description: In the "ROI (Drawn in Markups)" section, select the MarkupsROI node.

steps.description: Click the "Cofrim crop" button.

operations.description: Confirm cropping of the input volume to the selected ROI.

operations.description: Add a segment named Reference_Segment under Reference_Segmentation and set its color to Sage Green.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Threshold" button.

operations.description: Activate the Threshold effect in Segment Editor.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, adjust the threshold slider to set the segmentation range.

operations.description: Adjust the threshold slider to set the reference segmentation range.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Apply" button.

operations.description: Apply the Threshold effect to create the reference segment.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Islands" button.

steps.description: In the 2D view, click to select the reference part.

operations.description: Click in the 2D view to select the reference part using the Islands effect.

operations.description: Add a segment named Moving_Segment under Moving_Segmentation and set its color to Cyan.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Threshold" button.

operations.description: Activate the Threshold effect in Segment Editor for the moving segmentation.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Apply" button.

operations.description: Apply the Threshold effect to create the moving segment.
